description: The SyncManager class is responsible for managing synchronization tasks in the application, utilizing WorkManager to perform periodic and immediate synchronization with constraints on network availability.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: A singleton class that handles synchronization logic, including starting periodic sync, requesting immediate sync, and observing the sync state.

classes.name: SyncState
classes.description: A sealed class that represents the various states of the sync operation, including Idle, Syncing, Error with a message, and Success.

methods.name: startPeriodicSync
methods.description: Initializes and enqueues a periodic sync request based on network constraints.

methods.name: requestImmediateSync
methods.description: Initializes and enqueues an immediate sync request based on network constraints.

methods.name: stopSync
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing unique sync work.

methods.name: observeSyncWork
methods.description: Observes the state of the sync work and provides a Flow of WorkInfo.State to the caller.
